# interval starts

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalStarts`](gmeow-intervalStarts.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalStarts>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen STARTS: this interval and the related interval begin together, and this one ends first. NOT transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:intervalStartedBy`](gmeow-intervalStartedBy.md). (= [time:intervalStarts](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalStarts))

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when two intervals share a start instant but the subject ends first — an initial sub-span (probation, trial period) that begins with its enclosing span.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the intervals also share their end (use [`gmeow:intervalFinishes`](gmeow-intervalFinishes.md)) or are fully co-extensive (use [`gmeow:intervalCoincidesWith`](gmeow-intervalCoincidesWith.md)); STARTS is the shared-start-only case and is NOT transitive.

### How to use

- Assert from the shorter, co-starting interval to the longer one; the inverse [`gmeow:intervalStartedBy`](gmeow-intervalStartedBy.md) follows automatically (= [time:intervalStarts](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalStarts)).

### Examples

- ex:probation [`gmeow:intervalStarts`](gmeow-intervalStarts.md) ex:employment.
